purpose: Context KB for camt.057 NotificationToReceive auto-fixing. For each XML tag: datatype, mandatory, errors, possible_fixes so the AI fixer can insert correct structures and fix value errors.

iso_20022_rules.NTFCTN_ITM_MANDATORY: Each Ntfctn must contain at least one Itm [1..n].
iso_20022_rules.ITM_AMT_MANDATORY: Each Itm must carry an Amt (ActiveOrHistoricCurrencyAndAmount) [1..1].
iso_20022_rules.ITM_ID_MANDATORY: Each Itm must have an Id (Max35Text) [1..1].
iso_20022_rules.GRPHDR_MANDATORY: GrpHdr with MsgId and CreDtTm is mandatory [1..1].
iso_20022_rules.XPCTDVALDT_NOT_PAST: XpctdValDt (expected value date) must not be in the past.
iso_20022_rules.UETR_RECOMMENDED: Itm.UETR (UUIDv4) is strongly recommended under CBPR+ to correlate the notification with the originating payment.

cbpr_plus_formal_rules: AppHdr (BusinessApplicationHeader) is mandatory for all CBPR+ camt.057 messages.
AppHdr/BizSvc must be 'swift.cbprplus.03' for CBPR+ camt.057 messages.
AppHdr/CreDt must use format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM — 'Z' suffix is forbidden.
AppHdr/Fr and AppHdr/To are mandatory; each must contain a valid BICFI.
Itm/UETR if present must be a valid UUID v4 (lowercase hex, format xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx).
XpctdValDt must not be a past date (PAST_DATE_ERROR).
When BICFI is present inside FinInstnId, Nm and PstlAdr must NOT also be present (BICFI exclusivity).
AcctSvcr/FinInstnId/BICFI should identify the account-servicing institution.

tags.description: Business Application Header V02. Mandatory for all CBPR+ camt.057 messages.

possible_fixes: Insert a complete <AppHdr> block containing Fr, To, BizMsgIdr, MsgDefIdr, BizSvc, and CreDt before the <Document> element.

tags.description: Sender of the message (BAH). Must contain FIId/FinInstnId/BICFI.

possible_fixes: Insert <Fr><FIId><FinInstnId><BICFI>SENDERXXXXX</BICFI></FinInstnId></FIId></Fr> as first child of AppHdr.

tags.description: Receiver of the message (BAH). Must contain FIId/FinInstnId/BICFI.

possible_fixes: Insert <To><FIId><FinInstnId><BICFI>RECEIVERXXXX</BICFI></FinInstnId></FIId></To> after <Fr> in AppHdr.

tags.description: Unique identifier of the business message. Must equal GrpHdr/MsgId.

possible_fixes: Copy GrpHdr/MsgId value and insert as <BizMsgIdr>{value}</BizMsgIdr>.
Set BizMsgIdr to the same value as GrpHdr/MsgId.

tags.description: Message Definition Identifier. Must equal 'camt.057.001.08'.

errors.description: MsgDefIdr does not match the Document namespace.
possible_fixes: Set <MsgDefIdr>camt.057.001.08</MsgDefIdr>.

tags.description: Business Service identifier. The ONLY valid value for camt.057 under CBPR+ SR2025 is 'swift.cbprplus.03'. The validator rule CBPR_R8 (ERROR, expression VALUE == 'swift.cbprplus.03') enforces this. Any message with a different value (e.g. 'swift.cbprplus.02') must be fixed to 'swift.cbprplus.03'.

errors.description: BizSvc contains a value other than 'swift.cbprplus.03'. For camt.057 under CBPR+ SR2025, only 'swift.cbprplus.03' is accepted. The validator rule CBPR_R8 fires when the value is not the expected one.
possible_fixes: Set <BizSvc>swift.cbprplus.03</BizSvc> in AppHdr.
If the current value is 'swift.cbprplus.02', replace it with 'swift.cbprplus.03'.
If BizSvc is absent, insert <BizSvc>swift.cbprplus.03</BizSvc> after MsgDefIdr.
errors.ai_fix_note: Always use 'swift.cbprplus.03' for camt.057 — this matches the authoritative validator rule CBPR_R8.

tags.description: Creation date-time of the BAH. Format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM. 'Z' forbidden under CBPR+.

errors.description: CreDt uses 'Z' suffix instead of explicit offset.
possible_fixes: Replace trailing 'Z' with '+00:00'.
Append '+00:00' to the datetime value.

tags.description: Group Header. Contains MsgId and CreDtTm.

possible_fixes: Insert <GrpHdr><MsgId>MSG-ID</MsgId><CreDtTm>YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+00:00</CreDtTm></GrpHdr> as first child of NtfctnToRcv.

tags.description: Unique identifier for this notification message. Must equal AppHdr/BizMsgIdr.

possible_fixes: Add <MsgId>MSG-YYYYMMDD-001</MsgId> inside <GrpHdr>.
Truncate MsgId to 35 characters.

tags.description: Creation date-time of the message. Format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM. Must not be in the past.

possible_fixes: Add <CreDtTm>YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+00:00</CreDtTm> inside <GrpHdr>.
Replace with current datetime using format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+00:00.
Replace trailing 'Z' with '+00:00'.

tags.description: Message Sender. Contains Agt/FinInstnId/BICFI identifying who sends the notification.

possible_fixes: Replace BICFI with a valid 8 or 11 character BIC code.

tags.description: Account Notification. Contains Id [1..1] and one or more Itm [1..n].

possible_fixes: Insert <Ntfctn><Id>NTFCTN-001</Id><Itm><Id>ITM-001</Id><Amt Ccy="EUR">0.00</Amt></Itm></Ntfctn> as second child of NtfctnToRcv.

tags.description: Unique identifier of this notification.

possible_fixes: Add <Id>NTFCTN-001</Id> as first child of <Ntfctn>.

tags.description: Notification Item. Each item must have an Id and Amt. UETR is strongly recommended.

possible_fixes: Insert at least one <Itm><Id>ITM-001</Id><Amt Ccy="EUR">0.00</Amt></Itm> inside <Ntfctn>.

tags.description: Unique identifier of the notification item.

possible_fixes: Add <Id>ITM-001</Id> as first child of <Itm>.

tags.description: End-to-end identification from the original payment instruction.
Unique End-to-end Transaction Reference. Strongly recommended under CBPR+ to correlate the notification with the originating pacs.008/pacs.009 UETR.

errors.description: Itm/UETR is not a valid UUID v4.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid UUID v4: lowercase hex, format xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx.

tags.description: Amount of the notification item. Requires @Ccy attribute (ISO 4217 currency code).

possible_fixes: Add <Amt Ccy="EUR">0.00</Amt> inside <Itm>.
Add the Ccy attribute: <Amt Ccy="EUR">0.00</Amt>.

tags.description: Expected Value Date. Must not be in the past.

possible_fixes: Replace with today's date (YYYY-MM-DD) or a future date.

tags.description: Debtor (Party50Choice). Either a Party (Pty) or an Agent (Agt with FinInstnId/BICFI).

possible_fixes: Replace BICFI with a valid 8 or 11 character BIC.

tags.description: Debtor Agent. BranchAndFinancialInstitutionIdentification8 — contains FinInstnId/BICFI.

possible_fixes: Replace BICFI with a valid BIC code.

tags.description: Remittance Information. Contains Ustrd (Max140Text) or Strd.
Account being notified. CashAccount40 — Id/IBAN or Id/Othr.

errors.description: Ntfctn/Acct/Id/IBAN fails checksum or format validation.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid IBAN, e.g. GB29NWBK60161331926819.

tags.description: Account Servicer. BranchAndFinancialInstitutionIdentification8 — FinInstnId/BICFI.

errors.description: AcctSvcr FinInstnId has both BICFI and Nm/PstlAdr (BICFI exclusivity violation).
possible_fixes: Remove Nm and PstlAdr from FinInstnId when BICFI is present.

tags.description: Expected Value Date at notification level. Must not be in the past.

possible_fixes: Replace with today's date (YYYY-MM-DD) or a future date.

tags.description: Party authorised to receive the notification. Identified by BICFI under CBPR+.

errors.description: GrpHdr/MsgRcpt BICFI is not a valid ISO 9362 BIC.
possible_fixes: Set MsgRcpt/Id/OrgId/AnyBIC (or FinInstnId/BICFI) to a valid 8 or 11 character BIC.

tags.description: Owner of the account to be credited by the notified items. Identified by name or BICFI.

possible_fixes: Set AcctOwnr/Id/OrgId/AnyBIC to a valid 8 or 11 character BIC, or supply Nm.

tags.description: Account to be credited for this notified item; account identification is a choice of IBAN or Othr.

errors.description: Ntfctn/Itm/Acct/Id carries both IBAN and Othr, or neither.
possible_fixes: Provide exactly one of IBAN or Othr under Acct/Id.

errors.description: Ntfctn/Itm/Acct IBAN fails ISO 13616 check digits.
possible_fixes: Correct the IBAN so its MOD-97 check digits are valid, or use Othr/Id.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: AppHdr/BizMsgIdr must equal GrpHdr/MsgId.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Copy GrpHdr/MsgId and set AppHdr/BizMsgIdr to the same value.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: AppHdr/MsgDefIdr must equal 'camt.057.001.08' (the Document namespace identifier).
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Set <MsgDefIdr>camt.057.001.08</MsgDefIdr>.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Each Ntfctn must contain at least one Itm. Ntfctn without Itm is schema-invalid.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Insert at least one <Itm><Id>ITM-001</Id><Amt Ccy="EUR">0.00</Amt></Itm> inside <Ntfctn>.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Each Itm must have both Id [1..1] and Amt [1..1].
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Ensure every <Itm> contains <Id> and <Amt Ccy="...">0.00</Amt>.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Itm/UETR if present must be a valid UUID v4 (strongly recommended to match the originating payment UETR).
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Replace with a valid UUID v4: lowercase hex, xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: XpctdValDt (at Ntfctn or Itm level) must not be a past date.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Replace past XpctdValDt with today's date or a future date (YYYY-MM-DD).

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: When BICFI is present inside FinInstnId (AcctSvcr, DbtrAgt, etc.), Nm and PstlAdr MUST NOT be present.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Remove Nm and PstlAdr siblings from the same FinInstnId when BICFI is present.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: AppHdr/CreDt must not use 'Z' suffix. Use explicit UTC offset +00:00.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Replace trailing 'Z' with '+00:00'.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Ntfctn/Id must be unique per message and must not exceed 35 characters.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Generate a unique Max35Text identifier for Ntfctn/Id.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Itm/Amt/@Ccy must be a valid ISO 4217 3-letter currency code.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Set @Ccy to a valid currency code such as EUR, USD, or GBP.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Each Ntfctn/Itm/Amt must carry a valid ISO 4217 Ccy attribute consistent with the notified account currency.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Add or correct the Ccy attribute on Itm/Amt to a valid ISO 4217 code matching the account currency.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Currency Decimal Precision Check
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3_CURRENCY_001 constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Country Code Compliance (ISO 3166-1 Alpha-2)
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3_COUNTRY_001 constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Charge Bearer Code Validation
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3_CHRGBR_001 constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Postal Address Coexistence Rule: If Address Line is absent, Town Name and Country must be present.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the E001 constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Instruction ID is unusually long
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the W005 constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: BIC Existence in SWIFT Directory
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3_BIC_DIRECTORY_001 constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Urgent payments should normally be settled on the current date.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3_URGENT_DATE_001 constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Conditional Amount Limit based on Purpose Code
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3-PURPOSE-LIMIT constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: IBAN Based Currency Validation
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3_IBAN_CURR_001 constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: LEI cannot replace BIC for financial institution agents. CBPR+ requires BICFI.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3_LEI_NOT_BIC constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: IntrmyAgt2 cannot exist without IntrmyAgt1.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3_INTRMY_ORDER_1 constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: IntrmyAgt3 cannot exist without IntrmyAgt2.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3_INTRMY_ORDER_2 constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: ISO Purpose Code Validation (SR2025)
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3_PURPOSE_001 constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: ISO Category Purpose Code Validation (SR2025)
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3_CTGYPURP_001 constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: If Settlement Method is CLRG (Clearing System), Clearing System (ClrSys) identity must be present.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3_STTLM_CLRG_001 constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Party Identification: Organization ID (/OrgId) and Private ID (/PrvtId) are mutually exclusive. Both cannot be present.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3_PARTY_EXCLUSIVITY constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Financial Institution Identification: Must contain either a BICFI or a Clearing System Member identification.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3_FININSTNID_COMPLETENESS constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Party Identification: When an ID (Organisation /OrgId or Private /PrvtId) is provided, the Name field (/Nm) should also be included for reference.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3_NAME_FOR_ID constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Validation of scheme code for Organisation Identification. Allowed: LEI, DUNS, VAT, TXID, GIIN, CRN.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Use a valid Organisation scheme code like 'LEI' or 'DUNS'.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Validation of scheme code for Private Identification. Allowed: CCPT, DRLC, NIDN, SSSN, PASSPORT, NATIONALID.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Use a valid Private scheme code like 'CCPT' (Passport) or 'NIDN'.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Settlement Method must be one of the ISO 20022 standard codes: INDA, INGA, CLRG, COVE
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3_SETTLEMENT_METHOD constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Organisation identification cannot accompany personal name and vice versa (ENTITY_MISMATCH).
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Ensure the <Nm> tag includes a corporate indicator like 'Ltd', 'Corp', or 'Inc', or use <PrvtId> if this is an individual.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Organisation identification cannot accompany personal name and vice versa (ENTITY_MISMATCH).
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Remove corporate keywords (e.g., 'Ltd', 'Corp') from the <Nm> field, or use <OrgId> if this is a company identification.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Debtor and Creditor are mandatory for all payment messages. For customer credit transfers (pacs.008, pacs.003), Debtor Agent and Creditor Agent are also required.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Ensure <Dbtr> and <Cdtr> blocks are included. For pacs.008/pacs.003, also include <DbtrAgt> and <CdtrAgt>.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: AppHdr Priority Validation (HIGH, NORM, LOW)
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3_APPHDR_PRTY_001 constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Service Level Code (SvcLvl/Cd) must be a valid ExternalServiceLevel1Code.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3_SVCLVL_CODE constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Local Instrument Code (LclInstrm/Cd) must be a valid ExternalLocalInstrument1Code.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3_LCLINSTRM_CODE constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Clearing System Identification Code (ClrSys/Cd or ClrSysId/Cd) must be a valid ExternalCashClearingSystem1Code.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3_CLRSYS_CODE constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Cash Account Type Code (Acct/Tp/Cd) must be a valid ExternalCashAccountType1Code.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3_ACCT_TYPE_CODE constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Entry Status Code (Sts/Cd) must be a valid ExternalEntryStatus1Code.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3_ENTRY_STATUS_CODE constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: BIC must be exactly 8 or 11 characters (XSD pattern allows it; this gives a clearer error).
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: A valid BIC is 8 chars (e.g. NDEAFIHH) or 11 chars including a 3-char branch (e.g. NDEAFIHHXXX).

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: LEI must be exactly 20 alphanumeric characters (ISO 17442).
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3_LEI_FORMAT constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: JPY amounts cannot have decimal places.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Remove the decimal portion from the JPY amount (e.g. use '1000' instead of '1000.00').

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: IBAN must contain only uppercase A-Z and digits 0-9.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Remove any lowercase letters or whitespace from the IBAN value.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Party Name (Nm) should not be a BIC code — likely a mapping error.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Move the BIC value into <BICFI> and put the actual party name in <Nm>.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Settlement / execution dates more than 1 year in the future are unusual.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Verify the date is correct. Future-dated payments beyond 12 months are unusual and may be rejected by clearing systems.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: When IntrmyAgt1 is present, CdtrAgt must also be present. CBPR+ dependency rule: an intermediary agent requires a creditor agent to define the end of the payment chain.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Add <CdtrAgt><FinInstnId><BICFI>CREDITOR_BIC</BICFI></FinInstnId></CdtrAgt> to the transaction, or remove <IntrmyAgt1> if no intermediary routing is required.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Notification to Receive: Financial Institution identification must be a FinInstnId.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the CAMT057_001 constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Notification must contain at least one Item (Ntfctn.Itm).
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Add at least one <Itm> block describing the funds to be received.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Each Item must carry an Amt.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Add <Amt Ccy="USD">12345.67</Amt> inside the <Itm> block.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Expected Value Date should not be in the past (operational warning).
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the CAMT057_ITM_EXPCTDVALDT_NOT_PAST constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: For further description on the usage of the field, pls refer to the CBPR Plus UHB.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the CBPR_Character_Set_Usage_TextualRule constraint and correct the relevant field.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.note: Textual/informational rule — manual review required, no automated fix.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule:
The Business Message Identifier is the unique identifier of the Business Message instance that is being transported with this header, as defined by the sending application or system. 

Must contain the Message Identification element from the Group Header of the underlying message, where available (as is typically the case with pacs, pain, and camt messages, for example). If Message Identification is not available in the underlying message, then this field must contain the unique identifier of the Business Message instance.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the CBPR_Business_Message_Identifier_TextualRule constraint and correct the relevant field.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.note: Textual/informational rule — manual review required, no automated fix.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: The Message Definition Identifier of the Business Message instance that is being transported with this header. In general, it must be formatted exactly as it appears in the namespace of the Business Message instance.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the CBPR_Message_Definition_Identifier_TextualRule constraint and correct the relevant field.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.note: Textual/informational rule — manual review required, no automated fix.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule:

A user-specific value may be used, but please contact your Service Administrator before doing so to ensure alignment with general practice on your service.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.note: Textual/informational rule — manual review required, no automated fix.

This field may be used by SWIFT on SWIFT-administered services. For a description of reserved values, please refer to the Service Description for your service. Contact your Service Administrator for further clarification, if necessary.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule:
For Jurisdictional transactions,  Debtor/ Name is mandatory with either Debtor Account OR Debtor Identification (that is within a country or for regions under same legislations – eg EAA)

Countries impacted by the Jurisdictional rule:

schema_mapping_notes.Ntfctn_vs_Ntfctn: camt.057 uses AccountNotification23 as the Ntfctn type — NOT to be confused with camt.054 which uses BankToCustomerDebitCreditNotificationV10.
schema_mapping_notes.Party50Choice: AcctOwnr and Dbtr at both Ntfctn and Itm level use Party50Choice — either a Pty (PartyIdentification272) or an Agt (BranchAndFinancialInstitutionIdentification8). Prefer Agt/FinInstnId/BICFI for FI parties.
schema_mapping_notes.UETR_optional_but_recommended: XSD marks Itm/UETR as [0..1] but SWIFT CBPR+ strongly recommends including it to allow correlation with the originating pacs.008/pacs.009 transaction.
schema_mapping_notes.Amt_attribute: Itm/Amt is ActiveOrHistoricCurrencyAndAmount — it requires a @Ccy attribute. Omitting the attribute causes an XSD schema validation failure.
schema_mapping_notes.root_element: camt.057.001.08 root is /Document/NtfctnToRcv (NotificationToReceive); the AppHdr (BAH) precedes the Document.
schema_mapping_notes.biz_svc: AppHdr/BizSvc for CBPR+ camt.057 is 'swift.cbprplus.03' (NOT 'swift.cbprplus.02'); rule CBPR_R8 enforces this.
schema_mapping_notes.datetime_format: ISODateTime fields (AppHdr/CreDt, GrpHdr/CreDtTm) use YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM; no 'Z' suffix, no milliseconds.
